scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's official Creator workflow guidance dated 15 October 2026, current monthly creator trends, the Beauty Trend Report and relevant public Pinterest design-inspiration Pins were checked on 23 October 2026. The workflow guidance adds a durable creative-operating signal: connect demand research, board-based planning, portfolio/collage showcasing, platform-aware reuse, scheduling and analytics into one feedback loop. Current aesthetic trends remain topical executions rather than separate command needs. One public Pin was accessible and one returned HTTP 403; no inference was made from inaccessible content.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.25.0 with 720 commands was read before editing. Existing commands cover individual social assets, trends, campaign direction and performance testing, but none owns the full content lifecycle from research and planning through differentiated repurposing, cadence and analytics-led refresh decisions. Added /content-lifecycle-system without changing the 720 existing commands, bundles, settings or personal creative intelligence. Candidate v2.26.0 passed all 22 regression checks.
trends: Creator workflows are iterative: inspiration, planning, making, showcasing, reuse and measurement should operate as one loop
Boards and sections can convert loose inspiration into a coherent production plan before asset creation
Boards and collages can act as portfolios or story-led showcases rather than passive collections
Cross-platform reuse should extend asset life while remaining native to each format instead of duplicating the same post
Analytics should bookend the workflow: inform the next batch and identify high-performing older work worth refreshing
Current creator aesthetics include Copper Hair, Vamp Romantic and Glamoratti, while tactile offline hobbies remain seasonally relevant

commands_added.name: /content-lifecycle-system
commands_added.detail: Plans a complete research-to-refresh content lifecycle with board/brief organisation, platform-native asset roles, differentiated repurposing, cadence, back-catalogue reuse and analytics-led keep/adapt/retire/refresh decisions.

skipped: No separate Pinterest-board, collage, scheduler or analytics commands because those stages are more useful as one connected content-lifecycle system
No Copper Hair, Vamp Romantic or Glamoratti aliases because /beauty-trend-system, /theatrical-opulence, /emotional-palette and /trend-to-brand already translate those aesthetics safely
No generic AI-workflow command because the durable gap is creative lifecycle orchestration, not a tool-specific automation claim

No retro-futurism, chaos-packaging, neo-minimalism, saturation-revival or dual-aesthetic aliases because existing visual-style, packaging, trend-to-brand and taste-discovery controls already cover them
No visual conclusion was derived from the public Pinterest Pin that returned HTTP 403
